slides.title: 6 questions to ask before you hire a web developer.
Will I own my site and domain?
slides.body: Your domain, your content and your access should be in your name — not theirs.

slides.title: Will it work perfectly on phones?
slides.body: Most of your visitors are on mobile. Ask to see real sites on a phone, not screenshots.

slides.title: Can I update it myself?
slides.body: Changing a price or a photo shouldn't mean waiting for a developer.

slides.title: What exactly is included?
slides.body: Design, pages, hosting, SEO, emails? Get it in writing before you start.

slides.title: How long until it's live?
slides.body: A clear timeline with milestones tells you they have a real process.

slides.title: What happens after launch?
slides.body: Bugs, updates, questions. Know who you call — and how fast they answer.

slides.title: We answer all six in writing.
slides.body: Send us your project and get a clear proposal.
